identity: The profile pins the exact descriptor bytes by digest; every present declared member is checked against current bytes.
execution: The fixed universal macOS Node executable, its version, safe mode and required license are part of the executable closure.
files: Required runtime and legal members. Missing or changed bytes refuse. The original canonical output paths are retained in every exported extension.
auxiliary: Optional pinned third-party development sources, types, maps and documentation present in the npm distribution. They are not used by the packaged Head runtime and are not copied into a personalized extension. A present member with changed bytes refuses. Executable JavaScript cannot be assigned this role. Required licenses remain in files.
distribution: The npm archive carries its dependency tree through standard bundleDependencies. No dependency installation or runtime download occurs when the extension launches or exports.
authority: Member hashes, publisher references and package metadata grant no permission to connect, read an API, sign or land.
legacy: head-runtime-closure@1 retains its separate Node-client interpretation; execution and auxiliary metadata cannot be introduced under that version.
